feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: New space station crew launches from Florida on SpaceX's Crew Dragon capsule
entry.summary: The crew of four — two NASA astronauts, one from Canada, and a Russian cosmonaut — heads to the International Space Station after liftoff from the Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida.

entry.title: What a Pearly King taught me about Cockney rhyming slang and East London history
entry.summary: In mother-of-pearl suits, the Pearly Kings used to canvass East London for charity. The most famous one, George Major, died in August. A look back on this larger-than-life figure and the Pearly King tradition.

entry.title: Passengers recount chaos on Tel Aviv flight. And, FBI probes employee-data hack
entry.summary: What we know so far about the tense moments aboard a Tel Aviv-bound flight. And, the FBI investigates a cyberattack involving sensitive employee data.

entry.title: Picanha, prices and politics: What Brazil's favorite steak says about the election
entry.summary: President Lula promised Brazilians four years ago they'd be able to afford picanha again. Now, as he seeks another term, the price of the country's favorite cut of beef is telling a different story.

entry.title: En esta ciudad de Pensilvania, los dos partidos políticos buscan el voto latino
entry.summary: Los republicanos lograron avances con los latinos en el último ciclo electoral, pero la economía y la frustración por la política migratoria de Donald Trump han corroído ese apoyo.

entry.title: COMIC: How the census gives your state power (and what Trump wants to change)
entry.summary: The census is used to determine how much say your state has in Congress and the Electoral College. President Trump failed to alter it during his first term, but he's trying again ahead of 2030.

entry.title: Trade tensions mean fewer Canadians flocking to South Florida
entry.summary: This South Florida community is typically a refuge for Canadians fleeing cold weather, but trade tensions between the United States and Canada mean fewer are coming.

entry.title: Studying this super El Niño could save lives. NOAA is scaling back research
entry.summary: A powerful El Niño is already influencing extreme weather around the planet. During the last strong El Niño, federal agencies ramped up research in the hope of improving weather forecasts. This year, they won't be matching that effort.

entry.title: Egg prices have tumbled since Trump returned to office. Here's why
entry.summary: Agriculture experts say high egg prices were the result of severe avian flu outbreaks, but the Trump administration's tariffs and the war with Iran have also put pressure on farmers.

entry.title: SNAP's funding model is starting to change. Here's what that means for the program
entry.summary: States will start to pay a larger share of the bill to run the food assistance program, as federal funding for operational costs shrinks.
